front.title: A YANG Data Model for Scenario-based Network Resilience Validation

abstract.t:
Network resilience validation evaluates whether network services can maintain acceptable performance and recover within specified objectives under disruptive conditions. Such validation may be performed using simulation, emulation, or controlled laboratory testing. However, differences in scenario descriptions, evaluation criteria, and result representations make validation results difficult to exchange, reproduce, and compare across implementations.
This document specifies a YANG data model for scenario-based network resilience validation. The model standardizes the representation of validation scenarios, disruptive conditions, service-level evaluation criteria, and validation results. It also defines common evaluation semantics to support consistent interpretation of results across validation environments.
The specification focuses on interoperable representation of validation information. It does not define simulation algorithms, fault-injection procedures, or mechanisms for modifying production networks.
